specs.Compatible Devices: Smartphone, Tablet, Laptop, PC, Monitor, Projector, TV Box

features: Wireless HDMI Transmitter and Receiver Latest Upgrade Technology: Our Wireless HDMI has two connection modes for 90% of devices, and in addition to the traditional transmitter/receiver mode. llano HDMI wireless products have a new feature that makes mirroring easy with just the receiver. Simpler and easier to use. Receiver Mode, Simply connect the receiver (RX) and mirror without a transmitter. Simple enough for anyone to use immediately. Transmitter/Receiver Mode: Simply connect the Transmitter (TX) and Receiver (RX) and the device will connect automatically, no need to manually configure it for smooth use!

Wireless HDMI Transmitter and Receiver: Plug and play, the Wireless HDMI Transmitter and Receiver offers true plug-and-play functionality without the need for messy cables, Wi-Fi, apps, Bluetooth or complicated setup. Bluetooth HDMI easily connects to devices in seconds, while llano Wireless HDMI technology ensures zero latency for smoother operation and a tidy workspace while delivering seamless, high-quality streaming.

llano HDMI Ultra HD Quality: Wireless HDMI Transmitter and Receiver supports dual-band chip (5G + 2.4G) 1080P/60Hz Ultra HD output for an exceptional visual experience for learning, meetings, family gatherings and gaming. Please note that if your computer is out of power or unable to power the HD device, please plug the transmitter power supply into an adapter or micro power connector, the power supply requires (5V/2A) charging head.

165Ft/50M Wireless Transmission: Wireless HDMI transmission distance is up to 165 ft/50M with 5G/2.4G transmission for stronger and more stable signal. Smoother video. Reliable connection even through walls or obstacles.(Please note: If HDMI wireless transmission passes through a wall or encounters an obstacle, the transmission distance and speed may be affected).

Charge While You Use: Solving the problem of traditional wireless hdmi products, the new Type-c charging port allows you to charge smartphones, laptops, and more while you use them without the need for an external power source.

Wireless Mirroring and Extended Display: Wireless HDMI transmitters and receivers mirror or extend the screen as needed. You can easily project content from your laptop, camera or TV set-top box onto an HDTV, projector or monitor for a versatile experience.If you want to cast the screen directly from your mobile phone, you can directly Bluetooth connection mode .

Patented Design and Unrivalled Light Weight: The patented exterior design features a luxurious metallic plastic finish. The ultra-lightweight body weighs only 48.9 grams, making it easy to carry around. In addition, it can be quickly attached to your bag or wrist with the included strap! Whether you're commuting, travelling or just out and about, it's comfortable to use on the go. The lightness and convenience of this device can be experienced immediately!
